add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Back at the Avengers Compound, Bruce and Wanda stand together against Thanos, and in Wakanda they fight his army side by side: Bruce in the Hulkbuster armor, Wanda guarding Vision.
add.whoA: A fellow Avenger in the battle for Wakanda.
add.whoB: A fellow Avenger in the battle for Wakanda.

edit.text: When Wanda Maximoff expands her Hex, Darcy Lewis is swept inside and made into an escape artist in Wanda's sitcom.
edit.whoA: The woman who sweeps her into the Hex.
edit.whoB: An outsider she casts as an escape artist.

add.title: WandaVision#9
add.text: In the final battle, Darcy rams Director Hayward's car to stop him firing on Wanda's sons, siding with the family she has come to understand.
add.whoA: The woman she comes to understand, and stands up for.
add.whoB: The outsider who stops Hayward from shooting her sons.
